title: BNP Paribas Young Talent Team - Heads or Tails - Arthur Cazaux
description: In 2018, BNP Paribas launched the BNP Paribas Young Talents Team, in partnership with the French Tennis Federation (FFT). The support programme is intended to give 20 promising young French tennis talent the best possible chance of reaching the highest levels of competition and becoming the champions of tomorrow. The BNP Paribas Young Talent Team, mentored by tennis player Jo-Wilfried Tsonga, is part of the BNP Paribas Group's commitment policy towards today's youth. The young players in the programme will benefit in two ways: financial assistance to take part in their sport; human support to prepare them for the challenges of professional tennis (image management, English lessons, legal advice, planning ahead in case they eventually wish to switch careers, etc.).

asr.full_text: What is the most important thing in life? Being a soldier. Which country do you want to go to? Aleppo. Noa, the captain. I know a few songs, but I prefer to hear it as the captain. Right-footed I feel good on the right. I don't mind not being left-footed, because I have a good reverse jog. Outside Cat Max I don't mind because I have a good reverse diagonality. Exterior. Cat. Max. Iriana. A song, a song... I enjoyed Iriana when she was in Featuring with Eminem. I don't take a lot of traffic. I would say bus. Lutarde. It's serious. I'm someone who eats aet, mustard. Seriously. I'm someone who eats a lot, even for breakfast I'm full. Messi. He gives things away very easily, and I'm for Barcelona, so of course with Messi.
